item.title: Capture the Magic of School Life! Contest
item.description: Ready to tell your school's unique story? A school programme or activity that shaped you, little by little. A team that learns to move as one – on the field, on stage, or in the classroom. A teacher who knows when to challenge you – and when to check in. A moment that makes someone feel seen, included, and brave enough to try something new. Celebrate everyday scenes that show what school is really about – care, guidance, and collaboration. Submissions can include photos or videos taken from 1 August 2025 to 31 July 2026. Check this link out for more information about the contest.

item.title: Trial of Nurture Email Notifications
item.description: Dear Students, We will start a two-week trial of Nurture email notifications on Monday, 27 April 2026. This means that you may receive email updates from Nurture when there are new announcements or opportunities for you. 1. Announcements If there are new announcements for you, you will receive one email summary from Monday to Friday at 4.00 pm. 2. Opportunities If there are new opportunities relevant to you, you will receive one email summary every Friday at 10.00 am. Please note that you will only receive an email if there are new announcements or opportunities. If there are no new updates, no email will be sent. This is a trial to see whether email notifications are a helpful way to keep you updated. After the two-week trial, we will ask for your feedback before deciding whether to continue with this arrangement. Thank you! Regards, Mr Tan Hui Kuan tanhk@hci.edu.sg

item.title: 《2026黄城夜韵：脉》正在热卖中！An Evening of Drama 2026 Ticket Sales
item.description: 各位同学, 经过大半年的精心筹备，一年一度的《黄城夜韵》将在5月15日和16日于 Gateway Theatre 进行演出。在此，我们诚挚邀请你拨冗前来，共襄盛举! 今年《黄城夜韵》的主题为“脉”。 月永为脉。正所谓：今人不见古时月，今月曾经照古人。一轮弯月承载了人类太多的悲欢离合，构成交错复杂的情感脉络。脉，是生命的律动，是同根同源，是绵延不绝的文脉相连。 今年的三部剧题材迥然，风格各异，却于幕起幕落之间，共同诉说着“脉”的千回百转。朝朝暮暮，有人在荒岛的枷锁间挑起脊梁，燃起血脉里人性的火种；潮起潮落，有人在帘幕低垂之间，敲响渐稀的锣鼓，用脉搏的余温捂住即将熄灭的烛火；逆流回溯，有人渴望弥补曾经的遗憾，却幡然领悟断脉之处亦可长出生生不息的新芽。 《黄城夜韵》第45次幕布即将升起，让我们于戏里戏外，共同品味这座城的一脉相承。 以下是今年的演出详情: 地点: Gateway Theatre (3615 Jalan Bukit Merah, Singapore 159461) 日期、时间: 5月15日（7:00pm) 5月16日（1:30pm) 5月16日（7:00pm) 票价： 5月 15日（7:00pm) & 5月16日（1:30pm) Cat 1: $30 Cat 2: $28 Cat 3: $26 Cat 4: $22 Cat 5: $18 Cat 6: $15 5月 16日 (7:00PM) VIP 场 Cat 1: $34 Cat 2: $30 Cat 3: $28 Cat 4: $22 Cat 5: $18 Cat 6: $15 订票链接： https://www.sistic.com.sg/events/hcidrama0526 你们的出席与陪伴将是我们最大的动力。2026《黄城夜韵》，将因你而精彩! 谨此致谢！ 《黄城夜韵2026》筹委会 Dear students, The Hwa Chong Institution (College) Chinese Society proudly presents - “An Evening of Drama 2026”. An Evening of Drama 2026 is an annual student-led production by Hwa Chong Institution (College). For its 45th iteration this year, enjoy three different plays exploring the theme of “Pulse”, unveiling the countless joys and sorrows that weave together a complex tapestry of emotional connections. Pulse is the rhythm of life, a quiet beat that echoes through our shared histories, and the unbroken lineage of culture that stretches across time. Some stand tall amidst desolation, igniting the spark of humanity that courses through their veins; some fight to keep the flickering flame of heritage alive against the cold winds of change; while others long to heal old wounds, only to realise that where rhythm had once faltered, new life may yet take root and grow. As the curtains rise on our 45th production, we invite you to feel the pulse of our legacy that lives on in each of us. The details of the production are as follows: Venue: Gateway Theatre (3615 Jalan Bukit Merah, Singapore 159461) Date and Time： 15th May 2025 (7.00pm) 16th May 2025 (1.30pm) 16th May 2025 (7.00pm) Ticket Price 15th May 2025 7.00PM & 16th May 1.30PM Cat 1: $30 Cat 2: $28 Cat 3: $26 Cat 4: $22 Cat 5: $18 Cat 6: $15 16th May 2025 7.00PM (VIP SHOW) Cat 1: $34 Cat 2: $30 Cat 3: $28 Cat 4: $22 Cat 5: $18 Cat 6: $15 Ticketing link: https://www.sistic.com.sg/events/hcidrama0526 As there are limited tickets available, we hope that you will place your orders early, to avoid disappointment. We look forward to seeing you at this year’s production. Thank you! Warmest Regards, An Evening of Drama 2026 Organising Committee
